name: Moss Fiber
description: Springy moss stripped from a Mosskin shell. Weaving stock.

name: Seed Husk
description: The hard outer husk of a Mosskin seed.

name: Spore Dust
description: Fine luminous spores. Alchemists' filler.

name: Soft Mycelium
description: A felt of fungal threads; light padding.

name: Amber Fragment
description: A chip of Ambermite shell resin.

name: Resin Shell
description: An intact Ambermite carapace plate.

name: Glider Fur
description: Silky fur from a Lunari's glide membrane.

name: Moonleaf
description: A Lunari ear-leaf that shines faintly at night.

name: Crag Scale
description: A slate plate from a Craglet's back.

name: Dry Claw
description: A sun-dried Craglet claw; tough as flint.

name: Briar Spine
description: A woody thorn from a Thornback.

name: Thick Hide
description: Bark-tough Thornback hide.

name: Wing Membrane
description: A dusty Dustwing wing panel.

name: Dust Powder
description: Wing powder that drifts upward on its own.

name: Brook Scale
description: A clear, coin-sized Brookfin scale.

name: Clear Gill
description: A Brookfin gill veined with faint aether.

name: Reed Fiber
description: Tough fibre from a Reedstalker's body.

name: Marsh Sap
description: Sticky sap that hardens in air.

name: Rotwood
description: Spongy root wood, oddly warm.

name: Sap Core
description: The glowing knot at a Rotroot's heart.

name: Bark Plate
description: Bark grown over Aethrion armour plate.

name: Copper Joint
description: A working Aethrion copper joint.

name: Graftling Fragment
description: A hinged twig from a Graftling. Kindling, or a cheap splint.

name: Graftling Core
description: The brass hinge at a Graftling's heart, still oiled with sap.

name: Sapdrone Fragment
description: A glassy wing panel from a Sapdrone.

name: Sapdrone Core
description: A Sapdrone's sap tank, half full and still warm.

name: Vinecrawler Fragment
description: A length of vine wound round a brass gear.

name: Vinecrawler Core
description: The cracked jade lens that steered a Vinecrawler.

name: Root Sentinel Fragment
description: A root-laced stone plate from a Root Sentinel.

name: Root Sentinel Core
description: A Root Sentinel's lantern eye, jade light still flickering.

name: Sandcoil Fragment
description: A gritty scale from a Sandcoil, warm to the touch.

name: Sandcoil Core
description: The ember-bright gland that keeps a Sandcoil warm at night.

name: Glass Scarab Fragment
description: A chip of amber-glass shell.

name: Glass Scarab Core
description: The glowing ember a Glass Scarab rolls its glass around.

name: Dune Sentry Fragment
description: A carved sandstone block, brass band still attached.

name: Dune Sentry Core
description: A Sentry's visor-lamp, still glowing orange.

name: Sun Warden Fragment
description: A bronze plate from a Sun Warden, sun-hot.

name: Sun Warden Core
description: One mirror from a Warden's solar ring.

name: Tidehopper Fragment
description: A chip of a Tidehopper's back-plate, sea-smoothed.

name: Tidehopper Core
description: The springy tendon-knot from a Tidehopper's hind leg; it still twitches.

name: Coral Claw Fragment
description: A broken branch of the coral a Coral Claw wears.

name: Coral Claw Core
description: An intact crusher claw, coral and shell grown together.

name: Brine Automaton Fragment
description: A verdigrised copper panel from a Brine Automaton.

name: Brine Automaton Core
description: A working pressure valve, still holding brine.

name: Relay Guardian Fragment
description: A ribbed hose section from a Relay Guardian.

name: Relay Guardian Core
description: A sonar crystal that hums when held near water.

name: Frost Mite Fragment
description: A crystal splinter from a Frost Mite's shell.

name: Frost Mite Core
description: A mite's glowing core, full of a slow-thawing gel.

name: Prism Wisp Fragment
description: A shard of a wisp's crystal frame; it splits light.

name: Prism Wisp Core
description: A wisp's caught light, still warm in its frame.

name: Icegear Fragment
description: A frozen cog from an Icegear's body.

name: Icegear Core
description: An Icegear's drive gear-train, still meshing.

name: Archive Keeper Fragment
description: A facet of a keeper's crystal armour.

name: Archive Keeper Core
description: A keeper's data-slate; glyphs still scroll across it.

name: Ashcrawler Fragment
description: A plate of ash-crusted Ashcrawler shell, still warm.

name: Ashcrawler Core
description: The ember that glows between an Ashcrawler's plates; it never quite goes out.

name: Cinder Imp Fragment
description: A chunk of charcoal body from a Cinder Imp.

name: Cinder Imp Core
description: The hot coal at a Cinder Imp's heart. Wrap it before pocketing it.

name: Smelt Hound Fragment
description: A riveted iron plate from a Smelt Hound's flank.

name: Smelt Hound Core
description: A Smelt Hound's molten core in its ceramic housing.

name: Furnace Knight Fragment
description: A scorched plate of Furnace Knight armour.

name: Furnace Knight Core
description: The firebox regulator from a Furnace Knight's breastplate.

name: Null Wisp Fragment
description: A dim shard of condensed null light. Cold to the touch.

name: Null Wisp Core
description: The hollow white heart of a Null Wisp, still drinking the light around it.

name: Shade Carrier Fragment
description: A dented panel from a Shade Carrier's cargo hull.

name: Shade Carrier Core
description: A hauler's route computer, still murmuring stop names.

name: Lattice Drone Fragment
description: A hexagonal frame segment from a Lattice Drone.

name: Lattice Drone Core
description: A drone's lattice core, faintly humming.

name: Meridian Executor Fragment
description: A shard of an Executor's black ceramic shell.

name: Meridian Executor Core
description: The slit-mask lens of an Executor, its light gone out.

name: Dew Pearl
description: A pearl of condensed aether dew, found in one Mosskin in hundreds.

name: Fungal Core
description: The dense heart of an old Sporeling colony.

name: Aetherite Shard
description: A splinter of Aetherite, the crystal that ran Aethrion. Every artificer wants them.

name: Copper Gear
description: A small Aethrion gear, still true. Craglets swallow them; Barkwardens are made of them.

name: Field Ration
description: Hard bread and dried fruit. Restores 10% HP.

name: Minor Vital Tonic
description: A bitter green draught. Restores 25% HP.

name: Minor Focus Tonic
description: A cool blue draught. Restores 30% SP.

name: Traveler Boots
description: Moss-lined boots. The first thing every Wayfarer crafts.

name: Leafweave Coat
description: Glider fur woven on mycelium felt.

name: Copper Saber
description: Crag-scale blade on a copper-gear hilt. Vanguard.

name: Surveyor Bow
description: Briar-spine bow strung with wing membrane. Strider.

name: Aether Rod
description: A brook-scale rod tipped with Aetherite. Arcanist.

name: Guild Pass
description: Wayfarer Guild warrant. Opens Hollowroot Cavern's lift.

name: Resin Heart
description: A perfect amber bead from the core of an Ambermite colony.

name: Hollowroot Heartwood
description: Wood from the Warden's core, still pulsing with aether.

name: Newt Slick
description: Slippery skin-oil from a Mossback Newt. Tonic makers' base.

name: Moss Mantle
description: An intact moss pelt from a Newt's back; it never dries out.

name: Jadewing Scale
description: A scale of jade wing-dust that glows for days.

name: Glowdust Sac
description: The gland a Jadewing Moth fires its bolts from.

name: Barkhound Plate
description: A bark plate shed from a Barkhound's shoulder.

name: Ironbark Fang
description: A wooden fang as hard as iron.

name: Pruning Blade
description: A worn shear-blade from a Pruning Tender.

name: Graft Spindle
description: The spindle that winds a Tender's grafting tape; precise Aethrion work.

name: Thistle Fur
description: A tuft of burr-studded Thistlehare fur.

name: Cottontail Burr
description: A Thistlehare's tail burr, packed with seeds.

name: Antler Coil
description: A copper coil grown through a branch of antler.

name: Engine Antler
description: A whole antler tine, coils intact; it hums when held.

name: Bloat Membrane
description: Violet skin from a burst Sporebloat.

name: Spore Bladder
description: A sealed Sporebloat bladder. Handle gently.

name: Matron Mycelium
description: A felt of threads from a Spore Matron's stalk.

name: Spore Lantern
description: One of the jade lanterns that hang under a Matron's cap.

name: Piston Bark
description: Polished heartwood plate from a Pistonguard.

name: Heartwood Piston
description: A working piston, sleeved in heartwood.

name: Living Jade
description: Sap that has set into glowing jade around a thread of aether. Verdantis's prize; Sapdrones, Tenders and Sentinels carry it.

name: Regent's Heartspring
description: The mainspring of the Heartwood Engine's pump, grown through with living wood.

name: Ochre Pelt
description: A dusty jackal pelt. Tonic makers render it for oil.

name: Caravan Tag
description: A brass tag from a long-lost caravan, worn by a jackal. Collectors pay for them.

name: Kite Foil
description: A sheet of brass foil from a Brass Kite's wing.

name: Survey Lens
description: A Brass Kite's nose lens, still focused.

name: Basilisk Scale
description: A ridged, sun-baked basilisk scale.

name: Glasstail Club
description: The glowing glass club from a basilisk's tail.

name: Gnomon Wire
description: Fine brass wire from an Acolyte's calibrating arms.

name: Mirror Palm
description: An Acolyte's mirror-plate hand.

name: Strider Leg
description: A long, hollow Canal Strider leg.

name: Silt Pearl
description: A pearl a Strider grows from canal silt.

name: Grave Wrap
description: A strip of a Revenant's burial wrapping.

name: Surveyor's Lamp
description: The dim lamp a Dust Revenant carries. It never goes out.

name: Colossus Sandstone
description: A slab of the Colossus's body, carved with causeway marks.

name: Colossus Gear-Heart
description: The gear that drives a Colossus, big as a shield.

name: Prism Shard
description: A splinter of a Lens-drone's prism.

name: Focusing Lens
description: A whole Lens-drone prism, focused to a pinpoint.

name: Mirror Plate
description: A polished mirror-bronze plate from a Mirrorguard.

name: Mirrorguard Gimbal
description: The gimbal that aims a Mirrorguard's shield-mirror.

name: Sunfire Glass
description: Desert glass that trapped a bolt of focused sunlight; it glows by itself. Solenia's prize: Glass Scarabs, Basilisks and Lens-drones carry it.

name: Sovereign's Crown Lens
description: The master lens from the Heliostat Sovereign's crown.

name: Heliostat Key Prism
description: A prism cut to the Heliostat Vault's lock. The Guild gives it to Wayfarers who clear the Causeway.

name: Skimmer Plume
description: A brass-tinted flight feather from a Gullwing Skimmer.

name: Storm Quill
description: A crest feather that stiffens before a storm.

name: Polyp Barb
description: A spent stinging barb; handle by the base.

name: Stinging Polyp Sac
description: A full venom sac from a Polyp Spitter's crown.

name: Kelp Frond
description: A broad frond from a Kelp Tender. Edible, if you're hungry.

name: Tender Bulb
description: The glowing float bulb of a Kelp Tender's head.

name: Borer Shell
description: The drill-shell from a Hullborer's head.

name: Borer Rasp
description: A Hullborer's rasping tooth-ribbon; it files copper.

name: Skate Leather
description: Pearlescent skin from a Pearl Skate's back.

name: Skate Barb
description: The serrated tail barb of a Pearl Skate.

name: Hull Scute
description: A shell scute with a rivet grown into it.

name: Stormshell Plate
description: A whole shell plate fused with Aethrion hull copper.

name: Ray Wing Hide
description: A strip of Squall Ray wing that holds a static charge.

name: Charged Stinger
description: A copper-tipped stinger that sparks when tapped.

name: Drone Valve
description: A brass vent valve from a Pressure Drone.

name: Pressure Gauge Core
description: A drone's sealed gauge, its needle still twitching with the relay's pressure.

name: Gloom Jelly
description: A lump of Gloom Medusa bell that glows faintly in the dark.

name: Medusa Bell
description: An unbroken medusa bell, aether still pulsing in its nucleus.

name: Abyssal Pearl
description: A black pearl with a blue fire inside. Thalassia's prize: crabs, kelp, skates and medusae all carry them, one in hundreds.

name: Signalmind Lens
description: The Drowned Signalmind's eye-lens, still focusing a signal no one sends any more.

name: Rimehare Haunch
description: Lean frozen meat. The hunters' staple on the treeline.

name: Frost Whisker
description: A Rimehare whisker rimed with ice that never melts.

name: Glassback Fleece
description: Coarse ram wool, glass chips caught in it.

name: Blueglass Horn
description: A ram's horn grown of clear blue volcanic glass.

name: Coilscale
description: A frost-ridged serpent scale, cold to the touch.

name: Coolant Gland
description: A serpent gland full of Aethrion coolant.

name: Plough Plate
description: A dented armour plate from a Glacier Juggernaut.

name: Juggernaut Drive Coil
description: The furnace coil that drives a plough mech's tracks.

name: Silvered Shard
description: A splinter of a Mirrorshade; it reflects things that are not there.

name: Shade Mirror
description: An unbroken palm of mirror-glass from a Mirrorshade's heart.

name: Hoarfrost Wool
description: Frost-matted wool from a Behemoth's hump.

name: Behemoth Tusk
description: A curling tusk, ivory veined with ice.

name: Sentry Casing
description: White enamel casing from a Cryo Sentry.

name: Cryo Cell
description: A sentry's power cell, frost forming on it in warm air.

name: Data Strand
description: A thread of glyph-light that an Archive Specter left behind.

name: Specter Memory Core
description: A tiny crystal holding someone's recorded memory.

name: Lancer Icetip
description: A spent ice lance, sharp as glass.

name: Focus Prism
description: A Cryo Lancer's aiming prism.

name: Everfrost Prism
description: A prism of ice that never melts. Crystallis's prize: wisps, rams and mirrorshades carry them, one in hundreds.

name: Cryocore Heart
description: A shard of the Archive's cryocore, holding a cold no furnace can touch.

name: Slagback Wart
description: A knob of slag broken off a Slagback Toad's back.

name: Slagback Furnace-Gland
description: The heat gland in a Slagback's throat; herbalists brew it into tonics.

name: Tender Weld-Bead
description: A bead of weld metal from a Crucible Tender's arc arm.

name: Tender Arc Nozzle
description: A working Aethrion welding nozzle.

name: Skink Basalt Scale
description: A glossy black scale from a Vent Skink.

name: Skink Vent Bladder
description: The gas bladder a Vent Skink uses to dive into lava. Cool and blue inside.

name: Spitter Pumice
description: Light frothy stone a Magma Spitter coughs up.

name: Spitter Magma Crop
description: The heat-proof crop where a Spitter stores its magma.

name: Scrapling Rivet
description: An Aethrion bridge rivet, carried off by a Rivet Scrapling.

name: Scrapling Gear-Eye
description: The single glowing gear that serves a Scrapling as an eye.

name: Brute Slag Plate
description: A slab of set slag from a Slagforged Brute.

name: Brute Mould Seam
description: The seam line where a Brute left its mould, dense as iron.

name: Wraith Cooled Pour
description: Metal that cooled the moment a Pour Wraith died.

name: Wraith Mould-Core
description: The still-liquid centre of a Pour Wraith, sealed in its own skin.

name: Stoker Coal
description: Dense Aethrion coke from a Zero Stoker's hopper.

name: Stoker Firebox
description: A Zero Stoker's grille-faced firebox.

name: Living Ember
description: An ember that keeps itself alight, born where Furnace Zero's fire runs through Emberfall. Imps carry them; knights and stokers burn on them.

name: Zero Heartcore
description: A shard of Kiln Prime's Aetherite heart, still white-hot.

name: Lurk Bristle
description: A violet-lit spine bristle from a Gutter Lurk.

name: Lurk Eye-Lens
description: The reflective lens from a Gutter Lurk's eye; it sees in the dark.

name: Nullbloom Petal
description: A black glass petal that dims anything held behind it.

name: Nullbloom Bulb
description: The light-drinking bulb of a Nullbloom. Alchemists use it to draw out fatigue.

name: Mite Coupler Pin
description: A rail-steel pin from a Coupler Mite's jaw.

name: Mite Signal Chip
description: The status-light chip from a Coupler Mite's back.

name: Riftling Shadowhide
description: A scrap of Riftling outline. It folds smaller than it should.

name: Riftling Veil-Eye
description: A Riftling's pinpoint eye; looking through it shows the Veil.

name: Sparkwing Quill
description: A copper-foil feather that crackles with static.

name: Sparkwing Arc Gland
description: The organ that stores a Sparkwing's charge. Handle by the edges.

name: Sentinel Lattice Plate
description: A layered plate of sentinel armour.

name: Sentinel Halo Relay
description: The rotating ring from behind a sentinel's head.

name: Glyph Shard
description: One glyph of the Lattice's language, fixed in crystal when its swarm broke.

name: Glyph Seal
description: A whole sigil, intact. Scholars in Umbracrest pay well to read them.

name: Weaver Filament
description: A thread of solid lattice light from a Weaver's spinneret.

name: Weaver Spinneret
description: A Lattice Weaver's spinneret, still warm with violet light.

name: Violet Lattice Node
description: A junction of the Meridian Lattice, cut free and still carrying current. Drones, sentinels, executors and weavers are built round them.

name: Sovereign Heart
description: A shard of the Lattice Sovereign's crystalline core, the rarest thing a Wayfarer can carry out of Nocthaven.

name: Meridian Keysigil
description: A glyph-key cut from an Executor's mask. The Heart Warden lets its bearer descend into the Lattice Heart.
